title: Chapter 440
text:
"This morning, the famous singer Chen Xing was attacked on New Phylen Colony Planet No. 8 in the Rain Star System of the Colton Star Cluster, and his whereabouts are still unknown. According to the witness report from the staff, the kidnapper is the Black Star Mercenary, a mercenary group with a good reputation in the Colton Star Cluster. They are also the Field Team of Floating Dragon Island. The specific details are unknown at the moment. Our station is actively communicating with the local police department and Chen Xing's support team."

Hovercars surrounded the hole in the hotel wall. Other than the security forces that sealed off the scene, there was also a large group of media reporters. Some of them were from the New Phylen Alliance, and some were from the galactic media. Like sharks that smelled blood, they quickly arrived at the scene not long after the incident and fought to release the first-hand report.

If it was just a normal kidnapping, the media would not be interested in it. However, it was different this time. The target of the kidnapping was a celebrity, a celebrity singer, and the incident took place in a busy city. The kidnappers were actually a famous mercenary group. These reporters were very sensitive to hot topics, and they immediately noticed that something was wrong. Other than reporting the incident, they also started to fabricate all kinds of rumors and speculate about the inside story.

Assassination Mercenary

Love and Hate Conflict

Property Dispute

Anyway, the title and content were all aimed at sensationalizing the news. Chen Xing had many fans all over the Shattered Star Ring, and the news spread like wildfire.

The local police were very busy. If a galactic celebrity got into trouble in their territory, the negative impact would be very serious if they did not handle it well. Furthermore, Chen Xing was a guest performing in the Unification Day celebration, so the New Phylen Alliance's reputation would be lost if something happened to him. The Central Security Department had already started to pay attention to this matter, and the local sheriff was under a lot of pressure.

Just as the situation was brewing, no one expected that Chen Xing would come back on his own, and with him came the Black Star Mercenary. This development shocked the police and the media.

As soon as Fu Ding returned, he was surrounded by countless people. Reporters asked him questions at once, and the police parted the crowd to protect him. On the other side, the hover car driven by Han Xiao and the others was also surrounded by police cars.

After persuading Fu Ding, Han Xiao asked the eldest Volga to use a water-type healing spell to heal the wounds on Fu Ding's face. The effect was obvious. Although he was still a little haggard, Fu Ding had returned to the appearance of a handsome young man. Unlike Chen Xing's feminine and seductive appearance, when Fu Ding controlled his body, he exuded a kind of gentle aura from inside out, making people feel close to him and inexplicably like a warm man.

Having already thought of the wording in advance, Fu Ding calmly dealt with the media. In the past, when he was trapped in his body, he watched Chen Xing's actions from the side. Even if he had never eaten pork, he had seen pigs run.

If it was five years ago, Fu Ding would not know so many things. Chen Xing's memories and experience of using his body were all things that Fu Ding had never experienced before, and they all became his experience.

The police and reporters did not really believe the excuse that Fu Ding thought of, but since the person involved had personally come forward, the matter could only be left as it was. The local sheriff gave a warning and left immediately. The reporters all shook their heads and left dejectedly.

The person in charge of the hotel came forward and asked Han Xiao to compensate for the damages caused by breaking the outer wall. This was a legitimate request, and Han Xiao did not reject it. He paid a small sum of money and sent the hotel people away. He also woke up the driver of the hover car and paid him 20 Enas to repair the car. This was more than enough money.

After dealing with these miscellaneous matters, it was finally quiet. Just as Han Xiao was about to walk toward Fu Ding, Chen Xing's manager blocked in front of Fu Ding and yelled, "Mercenaries are not welcome here. Please leave immediately."

Chen Xing did not belong to any entertainment group. She had built her own logistics team, and most of them were female. Her manager was a purple-skinned Duna with big eyes. She was a young girl who was smitten by Chen Xing and was willing to work for him. At this time, she was glaring at Han Xiao with anger burning in her eyes.

Fu Ding coughed dryly and said, "I have something to announce. First, all the upcoming tours will be canceled. Clear my schedule."

"O-Okay." The manager could not care less about Han Xiao and hurriedly wrote it down. She turned around and saw Fu Ding staring at her. Her face turned purple with a tinge of red, and she was so embarrassed that she almost panicked. She quickly lowered her head, not daring to look at Fu Ding. She did not even know where to put her hands.

Seeing this, Han Xiao smirked and thought to himself, As expected of a main character. Her charm attribute is really high. She already has her own charm.

"Don't be nervous." Fu Ding smiled gently like a spring breeze. "Second, I want to temporarily stop performing and leave with these mercenaries."

"What's so good about that?" The manager subconsciously wanted to agree, but she suddenly realized what was going on. Her expression changed drastically, and she looked at Han Xiao with anger and hatred in her eyes.

"Sorry, I guess you guys will have to find another job." Fu Ding reached out and patted the manager's head. The manager who was like a furious lion a second ago immediately became obedient and cried.

Next to him, his female assistants were also crying. They looked at Han Xiao with hostility, as if he was a love rival. When they turned to Fu Ding, they had an aggrieved expression and rushed forward to hug him. This scene was like a group of lovelorn people. However, they did not blame their "ex-boyfriend". Instead, they forgave him and hugged each other in harmony.

Han Xiao's cheeks twitched.

If a handsome person could have a foot on several boats, then Fu Ding's potential was at least at the level of a hundred boats.

With high charm, one could really do whatever they wanted.

You, awesome.

Brother, I have nothing to say.

After disbanding the team and letting everyone pack up and leave, Fu Ding ignored Chen Xing's roar in his mind. He came in front of Han Xiao and spread his hands. "I'm free now. How are you going to help me?"

Han Xiao was about to speak when the interface suddenly reminded him that he had received a new mission.

You have triggered a hidden mission.

Mission Introduction: You have discovered that Chen Xing is actually a spiritual host. You have met the original owner of the body, Fu Ding. He has decided to completely deal with Chen Xing in his mind. Your choice is crucial.

Mission Completion Condition 1: Expel or kill Fu Ding's consciousness and let Chen Xing control the body.

Condition 2: Expel or kill Chen Xing's consciousness and let Fu Ding control the body.

Condition 3: Let Fu Ding and Chen Xing reach a settlement and take turns to control the body.

Condition 4: Unknown

Note: As long as one of the conditions is fulfilled, the mission can be completed. The mission reward depends on the outcome.

"I can still help Chen Xing?" Han Xiao was stunned. As he was familiar with Fu Ding's future, he did not think of this idea.

In that case, Fu Ding's fate as a main character was in his hands. If he helped Chen Xing, he would have no future.

That was interesting.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and carefully looked at the mission requirements again. The fourth requirement was unknown. According to his experience, this kind of hidden requirement usually gave the most rewards. Then, other than helping either side and letting both sides reach a settlement, what better results could there be?

No player had done this mission in his previous life. Han Xiao could only judge based on his many years of experience. The first two were simple and crude methods. The third requirement, however, required time for both sides to communicate. The only thing he could do was to let Fu Ding continue to control the body and create an environment where both of them could communicate harmoniously. Once Chen Xing regained control of the body, he would definitely cause trouble.

Furthermore, he had chosen to complete the mission himself. Deducing that, the fourth requirement should take a longer time.

Although he had just seen the mission, Han Xiao had already guessed a key point. Time was the difficulty. The longer he delayed, the more chances Chen Xing would have to try to seize control of the body. This was an unstable factor.

Moreover, Fu Ding's consciousness had been preserved until now because Chen Xing had held back. Otherwise, she would have wiped out Fu Ding's consciousness long ago. Perhaps it was because Fu Ding had saved her before, so she felt guilty and did not kill him. However, if Chen Xing was forced into a corner, once she recovered, she might kill Fu Ding without caring about anything else. Thinking about it, the reward for the first condition should be very little. No matter who controlled the body, the problem would be solved, so there was no mission failure.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao said to Fu Ding, "If you don't want to hurt Chen Xing, then I won't use destructive methods. I have a few ways to suppress Chen Xing. I have a Psychic in my team. Although he is not very strong, it is because of this that he can weaken Chen Xing without severely injuring her, making her unable to recover. If you want to solve the problem completely without hurting her, I can only rely on you to negotiate with her. At most, I will prevent her from seizing control of the body and let you take control. However, this way, you can't leave our side. Otherwise, Chen Xing might succeed at any time. "

These words were also meant for Chen Xing to hear, to prevent her from doing anything desperate.

"Alright, I'll give it a try."

Fu Ding nodded and smiled. He was very optimistic. "As long as I can control the body, it will be enough. Coincidentally, I learned the method to train my Psychic power from her memories. If my mental power becomes strong enough, she won't be able to do anything to me."

Hearing this, Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration.

He could roughly guess what the fourth condition was.
